description: Eco-stations Bus en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les éco-stations bus d'Île-de-France. Définition Une station bus (anciennement gare routière) est un aménagement polarisant la prise en charge ou la dépose des voyageurs de services réguliers de transport public routier. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Bus, Transports en commun, Géolocalisation, IDG, geoidf. The portal shows 168 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
